# Keepance

> Local-first AI workspace for professionals who handle confidential client work. Every chat with Claude, GPT, or Gemini becomes a real Markdown file on the user's machine. Documents and API keys stay on the user's machine; prompts go straight to the AI provider.

## What Keepance is

Keepance is a desktop application (Windows, macOS, Linux) that combines a Markdown editor, a workspace-aware AI chat, and profession-specific workflow template packs (Legal Practice, Tax Practice, Consulting Practice). Built with Tauri 2 + React + TypeScript. Approximately 25,000 lines of source.

Unlike chat-first AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude.ai, Gemini), Keepance treats files as first-class citizens. Every AI conversation produces a persistent `.aichat` file. Workflow runs save as `.workflow` files. Whiteboards, audio recordings, and research source cards all live as real files in a folder the user picks.

Unlike workspace-first tools (Notion AI, Reflect, Tana, Mem.ai), Keepance is local-first. Data lives on the user's hard drive in standard formats. No cloud, no accounts, no telemetry, no server-side AI.

## Who Keepance is for

Solo and small-firm attorneys, tax preparers and CPAs, independent consultants, and boutique agencies. Professionals who handle confidential client work and cannot pipe that work into a cloud service.

Keepance is not designed for enterprise teams, hobbyists, or users who want an all-in-one managed AI subscription.

## Differentiation (the five message pillars)

1. **Local-first**: files stay on the user's machine. No cloud sync, no telemetry, no server-side database. Keepance never sees the user's work; AI requests go straight to the provider the user chose.
2. **BYOK (Bring Your Own Key)**: users supply their own Anthropic, OpenAI, or Google AI Studio API key. Keepance never holds AI credentials and AI requests go directly from the user's machine to the AI provider.
3. **Chat-as-files**: every AI conversation produces a real Markdown file the user can open, edit, version, back up, or delete with regular file system tools.
4. **Profession-specific template packs**: workflow templates organized by practice type (Legal Practice, Tax Practice, Consulting Practice) covering the documents professionals actually produce for clients.
5. **Confidential by architecture**: documents and API keys stay on the user's machine; prompts go straight to the AI provider, never through Keepance servers. $49 Personal (one-time) / $149/yr Professional (includes one profession pack) / $499 Practice one-time (up to 5 seats).

## Pricing

| Tier | Price | What it includes |
|---|---|---|
| Personal | $49 one-time | Core editor, all 3 AI providers, unlimited workspaces, whiteboard, audio, research/citations, 1 year of updates |
| Professional | $149/yr | Everything Personal has + one profession-specific template pack (Legal, Tax, or Consulting) + commercial use license |
| Practice | $499 one-time | Everything Professional has + up to 5 seats + all profession packs + updates forever |

Sold via LemonSqueezy (merchant of record handles VAT, tax, refunds). 14-day refund window, no questions asked.

## Platform support

- Windows: NSIS installer signed by Microsoft Azure Trusted Signing (no SmartScreen warning)
- macOS: Universal binary (Apple Silicon + Intel) signed by Apple Developer ID
- Linux: AppImage and `.deb` packages

Auto-updates land via GitHub Releases for v1.0.8 and later, with minisign-signed update bundles.

## Architecture

- Tauri 2 (Rust) shell, React 18 + TypeScript 5 + Vite 5 frontend
- Zustand for state, shadcn/ui + Tailwind CSS for UI, CodeMirror 6 for text editing, TipTap for rich text
- Three AI providers: Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, Google Gemini (BYOK, streaming, tool use)
- File formats: `.md`, `.txt`, `.aichat`, `.workflow`, `.whiteboard`, `.source`, plus full read/write for `.docx`, `.xlsx`, `.csv`, `.rtf`, `.pdf`, `.pptx`
- MCP server support: Keepance speaks the Model Context Protocol and can act as a client
- No server-side state. No telemetry. No tracking pixels. Plausible analytics on the marketing site only.

## Privacy and security

- No data collection from the desktop app
- No telemetry
- API keys stored in OS keychain on macOS, encrypted file fallback elsewhere
- All AI requests go directly from the user's machine to the AI provider
- See https://keepance.com/legal/privacy for the full Privacy Policy

## Comparison to alternatives

- **Notion AI**: Notion is a cloud team workspace; Keepance is a local-first single-user tool. Notion AI is bundled at $20/month; Keepance uses the user's own API key; files stay on the user's machine and Keepance never sees them.
- **Obsidian (with AI plugins)**: Obsidian is the closest spiritual cousin, also local-first and Markdown-based. Keepance adds first-class AI chat, profession-specific workflow template packs, and built-in BYOK; Obsidian users build this from plugins.
- **ChatGPT Projects / Claude.ai Projects**: web-based, cloud-stored, locked to a single AI provider. Keepance is desktop, local, multi-provider, and the chat history is yours in Markdown.
- **Reflect, Tana, Mem.ai**: AI-first cloud notes tools. Keepance is local-first.
- **Cursor**: code editor with AI. Keepance is for non-code workflows (writing, planning, founder docs).

For per-competitor comparison pages, see https://keepance.com/vs/
